comparison.interpretation: Focused sliver candidate generation solves the candidate-ceiling problem, including tiny-hand row 12692, but the learned pair scorer cannot select the oracle pairs and regresses from the aug24 direct-pair scorer. The remaining blocker is selector scoring/calibration/supervision, not a need to shrink the candidate budget.
